coverage_note: Pear fruit senescence multiomics study; senescence meets aging relevance. Three qualifying units: temperature intervention (HT/LT vs RT) with senescence-timing outcome, dual-luciferase perturbation of microRNA-mRNA interactions, and transient transformation of the Novel_188/Pbr027651.1 module. Differential abundance, correlation, target prediction, network assembly, annotation, qPCR consistency, and cited external perturbations are boundary items.

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Perturbation interventions from prior external studies described in the introduction; not a current-report result.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Cited tomato ACS2 silencing / FYFL overexpression delaying senescence

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential abundance of metabolites between senescent/RF and temperature contrasts; a descriptive comparison excluded as differential abundance without an effect-estimation design.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Differential accumulation analysis of metabolic compounds

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: In silico target prediction assigning microRNAs to senescence mRNAs; excluded as prediction/association with no experimental identifying variation.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: microRNA-target prediction (psRobot) linking microRNAs to mRNAs

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Correlation between mRNAs and compounds to isolate senescence-associated mRNAs; excluded as association/correlation despite integrating omics layers.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Correlation analysis between differential mRNAs and compounds

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Differential expression counts identifying senescence-associated mRNAs; excluded as differential expression without a named causal design.
Technical validation that qPCR profiles correlate with sequencing profiles; a correlation check on measurement, not a causal design.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: RT-qPCR consistency validation of transcriptome and microRNAome

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Descriptive mapping of gene positions to chromosomes; no identifying variation or directed method.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Chromosomal location assessment of senescence genes

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Annotation and enrichment of gene families with causal/mechanistic wording; excluded as enrichment and causal language without a formal method or perturbation.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Functional annotation of TFs and auxin genes with 'involved/mediated' wording

excluded_boundary_candidates.boundary_note: Assembled interaction network inferred from prediction and co-expression; causal wording but an undirected/inferred network without a formal directed method.
Differential expression of microRNAs across senescence and temperature contrasts; excluded as differential abundance.
External literature on microRNA-senescence links cited in discussion/references; not an empirical result of this report.
excluded_boundary_candidates.candidate_label: Cited external work on miR319 regulating leaf senescence

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Postharvest temperature intervention (HT/LT vs RT) affecting pear fruit senescence and multiomics readouts
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Postharvest pear fruit (cv. Housui) flesh under storage
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Controlled environmental intervention with RT comparator producing a direct senescence-timing outcome and generating the multiomics outcomes. HT and LT are treatment levels kept as child contrasts of one temperature intervention, not split.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Room temperature (25 degrees C) stored fruits used as controls
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: Storage temperature treatment (HT 40 degrees C and LT 4 degrees C)
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Controlled assignment of harvested fruits to high, low, or room temperature storage groups

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Dual-luciferase assay testing microRNA-mRNA interactions underlying fruit senescence
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Molecular perturbation confirming the microRNA-mRNA interaction candidates generated by the integrated omics; mechanistic experiment supporting the report's senescence link. Distinct system and intervention from the fruit transient transformation, so kept separate.
qualifying_analyses.comparator: Reporter co-transfected with an empty vector
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: microRNA overexpression (35S:pre-microRNA) acting on reporter bearing the predicted target sequence
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Co-transfection of 35S:pre-microRNA effector versus empty vector with a target-sequence reporter in tobacco leaves
outcome_constructs: luciferase (LUC) reporter activity as readout of microRNA-mRNA interaction

qualifying_analyses.analysis_label: Transient transformation of pear fruit perturbing Novel_188 and target Pbr027651.1 in fruit senescence
qualifying_analyses.biological_system: Postharvest pear fruit (cv. Housui) in vivo transient transformation
qualifying_analyses.boundary_note: Targeted perturbation of the omics-derived Novel_188/Pbr027651.1 module with a direct senescence outcome. Gain/loss on Pbr027651.1 plus Novel_188 overexpression are kept as one design unit (same system, method, single regulatory link); qPCR confirms the assigned perturbations.
qualifying_analyses.exposure_or_intervention_construct: Overexpression and silencing of Pbr027651.1 and overexpression of microRNA Novel_188
qualifying_analyses.identifying_variation_or_assignment: Agrobacterium-mediated transient overexpression and VIGS silencing in pear fruit versus empty control vector
